newsitem.title: CANADA: PacRim Information in diamond venture.
newsitem.headline: PacRim Information in diamond venture.

text.p: PacRim Information Systems Inc said on Thursday that it had entered a joint venture agreement with Brazilian company Mineracao Juina Mirim Ltda to acquire a 60 percent interest in a Mineracao diamond mining project.

PacRim said it acquired two properties in the venture in the municipality of Juina, Mato Grosso, Brazil. It added that the Juina region has a history of producing large diamonds of more than 50 carats.
An independent qualifying report noted the presence of at least 24 kimberlites in the immediate vicinity of the Juina properties, PacRim said in a statement.
PacRim is a mining and technology company with corporate headquarters in British Columbia.
